name: axtory
description: Local-first, evidence-aware analytics for AI-assisted work

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test --test-isolation=none dist/test/**/*.test.js dist/test/**/**/*.test.js
scripts.spike:codex: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js spike-codex --json-out .local/axtory-codex-spike.json
scripts.skeleton: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js collect-fixture --fixture fixtures/synthetic/normal-session.json --data-dir .local/axtory --json-out .local/axtory/output.json
scripts.collect:claude: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js collect-claude --data-dir .local/axtory-claude --json-out .local/axtory-claude/output.json
scripts.collect:codex: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js collect-codex --data-dir .local/axtory-codex --json-out .local/axtory-codex/output.json
